title.narrative: Programa de Fortalecimiento de la Poltica Pblica y la Gestin Fiscal para la Atencin de la Crisis Sanitaria y Econmica Causada por la COVID-19 en Barbados II
Programme to Strengthen Public Policy and Fiscal Management in Response to the Health and Economic Crisis Caused by COVID-19 in Barbados II

description.narrative: El objetivo general de desarrollo es fortalecer la eficiencia y eficacia de la poltica pblica y la gestin fiscal en Barbados en respuesta a la crisis sanitaria y econmica provocada por el COVID-19, mediante el diseo e implementacin de medidas de poltica eficaces y fiscalmente responsables. Los objetivos especficos de desarrollo son: (i) promover la disponibilidad y ejecucin oportuna de los recursos pblicos para responder a la crisis sanitaria ocasionada por el COVID-19; (ii) fortalecer el efecto contracclico de la poltica fiscal a travs de la introduccin temporal de medidas para proteger los ingresos de los hogares vulnerables y aumentar la liquidez de las empresas durante la crisis sanitaria y econmica; y (iii) promover la recuperacin econmica y fiscal durante el perodo posterior a la pandemia.

The general development objective is to strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of public policy and fiscal management in Barbados in response to the health and economic crisis caused by COVID 19, through the design and implementation of effective and fiscally responsible policy measures. The specific development objectives are to: (i) promote the availability and timely execution of public resources to respond to the health crisis caused by COVID-19; (ii) strengthen the countercyclical effect of fiscal policy through the temporary introduction of measures to protect the income of vulnerable households and increase liquidity for businesses during the health and economic crisis; and (iii) promote economic and fiscal recovery during the post pandemic period.
